name: My Zypp Stikks 28 Pack x 1g Prerolls - Orange Cream Pop
description:
Twenty-eight joints, one jar. The My Zypp Stikks Orange Cream Pop 28-pack gives you twenty-eight full-gram pre-rolls — 28 grams total — rolled and ready to smoke, packed in a sealed jar that keeps them fresh. No grinding, no rolling, no running out.

Orange Cream Pop nails that frozen-treat nostalgia: bright, juicy orange up front swirled with smooth vanilla cream and a sweet, mellow finish.

28 × 1G pre-rolls — 28 grams total, serious value in one jar
Jar packaging — keeps every joint fresh and protected
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Orange Cream Pop flavor — juicy orange swirled with vanilla cream

My Zypp Stikks Orange Cream Pop is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
